facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on October 9, 2019 an agreement with Nielsen to leverage Nielsen's Digital Brand Effect solution and Nielsen Audience Segments.
facts.quote: Toronto, ON – October 9, 2019 – StackAdapt ([www.stackadapt.com](https://www.stackadapt.com/)), a programmatic advertising technology company, today announced an agreement with Nielsen

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's announcement, Nielsen Audience Segments give Canadian-market reach of over 28 million unique users.
facts.quote: This will also provide unprecedented reach to the Canadian market with over 28 million unique users.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Michael Shang stated that Nielsen Audience Segments are being ingested into StackAdapt's 3rd-party catalogue, covering audience segments across verticals including consumer packaged goods, automotive, and B2B.
facts.quote: Our clients will benefit from the ability to customize their audience strategy around highly granular consumer characteristics across a variety of verticals including consumer packaged goods, automotive, B2B and more

facts.fact: According to Nielsen's company description, Nielsen has operations in over 100 countries, covering more than 90% of the world's population.
facts.quote: Nielsen has operations in over 100 countries, covering more than 90% of the world’s population.

facts.fact: Nielsen's own description says it has provided data and analytics for more than 90 years.
facts.quote: For more than 90 years Nielsen has provided data and analytics based on scientific rigor and innovation
